fieldData.full-article-text: The Olympia Betanet commences on April 28th 2021, and will provide a final, large-scale stress test of the protocol that will be offered to our community for the Olympia Mainnet - which will be the first live version of the Radix public network. Our Betanet is purely a test network created by Radix and will be shut down prior to the launch of the fully decentralized Olympia Mainnet.
